projects.name: Data Access Auditor
projects.description: A Windows desktop tool that audits Qlik Sense security: validates QMC rules, data-connection, session and sheet-level access for any user, so admins can prove who can see what before it hits production.

download.label: Download for Windows
download.note: Windows 10/11 only. SmartScreen may ask you to confirm: click “More info → Run anyway”.

videos.title: Everything you need to know
videos.desc: A tour of Data Access Auditor: what it audits, who it is for, and how it fits into a Qlik Sense governance workflow.

videos.title: Get it for free
videos.desc: How to request and download the free edition of the tool.

videos.title: Installation, step-by-step
videos.desc: Installing the app on Windows and connecting it to a Qlik Sense server.

videos.title: Configure access control
videos.desc: Fine-tuning certificates, endpoints and user directories.

videos.title: Validate QMC security rules
videos.desc: See exactly which QMC security rules grant or block access for a given user.

videos.title: Data connection access
videos.desc: Validate which data connections each user can read, update or delete.

videos.title: Session access
videos.desc: Audit session-level access rules per user to catch over-permissioned accounts.

videos.title: Check sheet access
videos.desc: Confirm which users can open which sheets in an app.

projects.name: Qlik Chatbots
projects.tagline: BI answers in any chat app
projects.description: One Node.js backend that turns natural-language questions into live Qlik Sense charts and KPIs, delivered on Microsoft Teams, WhatsApp, Alexa, Google Assistant and Telegram.

videos.title: Microsoft Teams bot
videos.desc: Ask for KPIs inside Teams and get guided suggestions plus live Qlik charts back in the conversation.

videos.title: WhatsApp bot
videos.desc: The bot replies on WhatsApp with a rendered chart, last-reload time and narrative.

videos.title: Alexa voice skill
videos.desc: Ask Alexa for a metric and hear the answer read straight from Qlik Sense.
